items.title: Hashtag Kalakar Fully Funded Artists Residency
items.location: Multiple global cities (artist choice: NYC, Paris, Berlin, Florence, Tokyo, Mumbai, Jaipur and others)
items.funding:
Fund: application fee only
Application fee: USD $50
Programme fee: none (covered if selected)
Travel: covered (round-trip economy if selected)
Stay: covered (accommodation for 30 days if selected)
Living: you pay (food and personal expenses not included)
You pay in total: USD $50 (plus living costs if selected)
items.eligibility: Visual artists (painting, drawing, sculpture, mixed media, digital, etc.), any nationality, age 18+. Degree: not required. Who can apply: emerging to established visual artists worldwide. IELTS: not required. NET: not required. Language: English. Age: 18+.
items.visaSponsor: Invitation letter provided; visa approval depends on embassy
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Hashtag Kalakar page. Participation fee USD 50 for jury; if selected among top 25, flights, accommodation and programme covered. Food/personal not covered. Registration deadline 25 October 2026 EST; submission 31 October 2026.

items.title: After the Single Use Artist in Residence – Hyderabad
items.org: After the Single Use / NOBA / University of Hyderabad
items.location: Hyderabad, Telangana (Department of Anthropology, University of Hyderabad)
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered (INR 70,000 budget for accommodation & travel)
Stay: covered (INR 70,000 budget for accommodation & travel)
Living: covered (artist fee INR 255,000)
You pay in total: not stated (budgets provided: artist fee INR 255,000, materials INR 102,000, accom & travel INR 70,000)
items.eligibility: Artists any medium interested in research on single-use medical plastics, waste, health and material culture. Degree: not required. NET: not required. Language: Telugu, Hindi, English. Age: not stated.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official After the Single Use page and Hyderabad-specific PDF. Part-time research-embedded residency Mar-May 2027 with University of Hyderabad anthropologists. Artist fee INR 255,000, materials INR 102,000, accommodation & travel budget INR 70,000. Artist arranges own stay/travel but funded. Deadline 23 October 2026.
